events.title: Points of Contact - The Sharps Jam
events.description:
Welcome to your Points of Contact. This is a sharps jam for you to play with or around like-minded and experienced people who are into needles, knives, staples, blood or other sharp fantasies. This is a non-teaching space. Hanging out, watching and absorbing the ambiance and practices is also welcome. There are side-rooms for meeting people and socialising outside of the intimate atmosphere of the main play-space. We welcome all bodies. There will be play-appropriate music, extra special lighting and snacks. In the last hour of the jam, we will lower the lights to allow for a slow and gentle transition and easing out. 
Note

This event is not for first timers. You must have previous experience and confidence in the sharps play that you’re doing and how to handle things if it starts going wrong.
If you are not confident that you have enough experience, do not despair! Please simply come to the Points of Entry – Fundamentals workshop earlier that afternoon, that is event is for first timers. Then you will be skilled enough and ready to happily come to this jam.
Please arrive before 19:50 when we will do a quick intro round, so everyone has lots of time to play.

Please bring your own sharps equipment and kit to play with. If you do not have a couple of these supplies, you can dip into our supplies stock, which is limited, in return for a small donation to cover the cost of whatever you want to use. Most things like first aid and needles can be covered by a couple of euros, however, separately, staplers are €7.50 each, staple removers are €2.50 each and knives are €5 each. Please bring cash, or you can scan a QR code to do a bank transfer in the moment. Please also bring your own clean waterproof sheet/orgy mat to play on, which you can lay on top of our mats. We also have back-ups for this if you don’t have one.

events.description: A-Trane präsentiert: WOLFGANG HAFFNER SUMMER SPECIAL FEAT : Ulf Wakenius-Thomas Stieger Zum Jubiläum lädt Wolfgang Haffner zu einem ganz besonderen Summer Special ins A-Trane ein. Gemeinsam mit langjährigen musikalischen Weggefährten wie Ulf Wakenius, Christopher Dell und Thomas Stieger, sowie den Shooting Stars Jakob Manz und Nils Kugelmann, präsentiert er musikalische Wegmarken einer einzigartigen Karriere . Das „Wolfgang Haffner Summer Special“ ist eine musikalische Feier – für Haffner selbst, für sein Publikum und für die verbindende Kraft des Jazz. Wolfgang Haffner Wolfgang Haffner zählt zu den herausragenden Persönlichkeiten des europäischen Jazz – ein Schlagzeuger von Weltformat, der in diesem Jahr beeindruckende 50 Jahre Bühnenpräsenz feiert. Mehr als 4000 Konzerte in über 100 Ländern, Mitwirkung auf rund 400 Alben, zwei ECHO Jazz- Auszeichnungen – Haffners musikalische Vita liest sich wie ein internationales Erfolgsmärchen. Ob mit Al Jarreau, Chaka Khan, Pat Metheny, Gregory Porter, Bill Evans oder Klaus Doldinger, ob mit Till Brönner, Hildegard Knef, Nils Landgren, Nightmares On Wax oder Die Fantastischen Vier – die Liste seiner Kollaborationen ist ebenso lang wie klangvoll. Sein unverkennbarer Stil, seine Vielseitigkeit und sein feines Gespür für Groove machen ihn zu einem der meistgefragten Schlagzeuger weltweit . Ulf Wakenius Knapp elf Jahre war Ulf Wakenius Gitarrist im Quartett des legendären Oscar Peterson , bis zu dessen Tod im Jahr 2007, ebenso spielte er jahrelang mit Bassist Niels Henning Orsted Pedersen. Eine wichtige musikalische Partnerin ist die koreanische Sängerin Youn Sun Nah, mit der er, zumeist im Duo, innerhalb der letzten Jahre hunderte umjubelte Konzerte rund um den Globus spielte. Auf seinen Aufnahmen als Leader zeigt sich der hochvirtuose Gitarrist oft von seiner ruhigen, melodischen Seite, zumeist an der Akustikgitarre – mit Bearbeitungen der Musik von Esbjörn Svensson oder Keith Jarrett ebenso, wie bei seinen stimmungsvollen, oft weltmusikalisch gefärbten Eigenkompositionen. Thomas Stieger Thomas Stieger hat sich als äußerst vielseitiger Bassist, Produzent und Komponist in der vielfältigen europäischen Musikszene einen Namen gemacht . Als gefragter Studiomusiker und Sideman arbeitet er mit einer Vielzahl national und international renommierter Künstler zusammen; dabei bewegt er sich mühelos zwischen den Genres Pop, Rock, Soul und Jazz und tritt weltweit auf. Nach der Veröffentlichung zweier von der Kritik gefeierter Alben mit seiner Band „Marriage Material“ (gemeinsam mit Felix Lehrmann, Arto Mäkelä und Raphael Meinhart) brachte Thomas 2024 sein erstes Soloalbum „CHOICES“ (Jazzline/Leopard) heraus. Darauf sind Gastbeiträge solch illustrer Größen wie Randy Brecker, Will Lee, Tim Lefebvre, Wolfgang Haffner, Aly Keïta und Rhani Krija sowie seiner Label-Kollegen Simon Oslender und Alma Naidu zu hören. events.title: Carlota Flâneur
events.description:
Carlota Flâneur is a catalan singer-songwriter who will be playing her songs live in Berlin for the first time on Aug 23 at Donau115.

She debuted in 2020 with Brains, her first EP. Back then she already stood out for her capacity to combine brilliant melodies with raw, no-filter lyrics. Uncertainty, her first album, managed to broaden her sonic universe and consolidated her artistic view, filling it with colorful, warm and catchy tunes.

In 2024 Carlota released Relate, a single in which she joined forces with two of her favourite catalan artists: Núria Graham and Marta Knight, to deliver a polished, smooth and dreamy tune.

Flâneur wanted to further expand her colour palette, and so she did in her latest album, What my body wants. This album is a balanced mix of light and shadow, full of interesting textures and harmonies that are perfectly placed to elevate the catalan’s fully recognisable songwriting.

events.title: Piena
events.description: Piena writes songs for overthinkers. Her biggest dream is to write a perfect love song. Until then, she writes about longing, self-deception, and the darker sides of the psyche. A singer, songwriter, and aspiring multi-instrumentalist from Amsterdam, she grew up with classical music, trained as a jazz vocalist, and now makes pop music. At first, that was confusing, but now she feels most at home in the in-between space; her sound is both analog and electronic, her lyrics are often as light-hearted as they are tragic, and you never know for sure where the delusion ends and the irony begins.

events.description:
Grown up in Dirkshorn and currently living in Amsterdam, Dutch drummer Wouter Kühne will share the stage with Berlin based musicians Kit Downes and Phil Donkin. The trio will perform a combination of jazz standards and original compositions of all band members. 

Wouter Kühne(1996) was born into a musical environment, with both parents being professional musicians. At 13 years of age he was admitted to the Junior Jazz College, a prestigious young talent program at the Conservatory of Amsterdam. In 2014 he started his bachelor studies at the same conservatory, where he graduated summa cum laude in 2018. Meanwhile, he already found himself collaborating with artists like Dick Oatts, Terrell Stafford, Aaron Parks, Joe Cohn, Bob Mintzer, Jason Marsalis, Dennis Mackrel, Benjamin Herman, Joris Roelofs, Jesse van Ruller, Reinier Baas and Maarten Hogenhuis. 

In 2017 he won the Sena Performers “Gouden Slifje”, a prize that represents one of most young promising jazz drummers of the moment. In 2019 he moved to New York City to study at the Manhattan School of Music, where musicians like Kendrick Scott, John Riley, Marc Carey and Phil Markowitz were among his regular teachers. Currently based in Amsterdam, Wouter shares the stage regularly with artists like Ben van Gelder, Jasper Blom and Harmen Fraanje. As a timbale player, he is a member of both the quartet and timba formation of Cuban Singer Evelyn Dupuy, playing traditional and modern Cuban music.

events.title: Refinement - A Deep Dive Masterclass with Murasaki Haruan
events.description:
There is a point in the journey of learning to tie, where spectacle stops being impressive. A deeper complexity emerges, not in knots and patterns, but in the interpersonal and vulnerable.
 
This two-day intensive workshop with Murasaki Haruan offers a rare opportunity to step over that threshold.
 
Rooted in the philosophy of Yukimura-ryu, this is not a workshop about acquiring more patterns, more ties, or more theatrics. Instead, it is an invitation to deliberately return to the fundamental sequences 片足開脚（KataAshi Kaikyaku) and 獣縛りKemono), and to explore them with a level of attention that transforms the familiar into something more profound.
 
Across 12 hours of in-person teaching, these two sequences will be examined from multiple perspectives. Through repetition, variation, and subtle adjustment, participants will begin to encounter the depth that only reveals itself over time. This is a practice of refinement, where intention replaces habit, and nuance becomes the language. It is a challenge in patience and stepping outside your comfort zone.
 
Murasaki’s teaching does not follow a westernized format. It draws from a distinctly Japanese approach to transmission: slow, immersive, and often indirect. Meaning is not always explained – it is experienced, sensed, and gradually understood. Like an apprentice observing a master over years, participants are invited to engage not only with what is shown, but with what is implied.
 
The weekend includes exercises, demonstrations, and renbaku – a format in which participants take turns tying the same model alongside the teacher – offering an intimate lens into timing, touch, and presence. Conversation and reflection are woven throughout, creating space for insight to emerge organically.
 
This is not about learning more. It is about diving deeper into what you already think you know.
 
What to expect


A deep exploration of one foundational Yukimura form into advanced territory

Guided exercises focusing on precision, timing, and intention 

Renbaku practice: rotating through the same model with the instructor 

Demonstrations that emphasize subtlety over spectacle 

A non-linear teaching style rooted in observation and embodied learning 

Space for discussion, reflection, and quiet integration 


Who is it for


Experienced shibari practitioners with a rooted tying practice 

Those who have explored complex structures and now seek depth over novelty 

Practitioners interested in traditional Japanese approaches to learning 

Individuals drawn to refinement, restraint, and nuanced expression 

Those willing to engage with challenge, repetition, and subtlety


Application
This masterclass works with applications, only. In order to apply, please email us with a short introduction and relevant information about you as a pair und your knowledge in Yukimura-ryu. If you would like to use our in-house sleep over option and/or pay in installments, please let us know in your application. We kindly as you to send your application to mamana@karada-house.de. We will review all applications on a rolling basis. We give priority to LGBTQIA+ and other marginalized groups. 
Please not that this weekend demands specific knowledge and constellations: 
Person tying: 

You must be proficient in tying the Yukimura-ryu sequences 片足開脚（KataAshi Kaikyaku) and 獣縛りKemono) and forms (i.e. Yukimura-ryu gote, etc.) and be able to execute them easily and well,
You must be able to tie any other standard shibari forms (i.e. tengu, futomomo, etc) easily. The general standard of technical rope expertise for the person tying should be quite advanced.

Person being tied:


you must have prior experience in being tied in this style and are willing to dive deep into emotional territory with your partner

As a pair: 

you must have an established rope relationship with each other, trust each other and have very good rapport. You must be willing to delve deep into emotional territory with each other. Please note that we do not accept pairings of people who do not know each other well for this particular class as it does not suit the topic.

Private Lessons with Murasaki

events.title: Roland Satterwhite
events.description:
Roland Satterwhite presents a solo performance for violin, voice, and a self-developed live harmonizer. Combining modern jazz with original songs rooted in storytelling and political reflection, the project explores the expressive possibilities of the violin as a complete musical language, with the harmonizer extending its harmonic possibilities in real time. This new solo project is the result of years of exploring how a single instrument can carry the depth, complexity, and narrative arc of a full musical world.

Roland Satterwhite is a Berlin-based American violinist, singer, and composer whose music moves between modern jazz, Latin American traditions, Sinti and Romani music, and political folk-rock. After years of performing in New York and across Europe, he has developed a distinctive voice that brings together improvisation, composition, and songwriting. His work draws from diverse musical traditions, exploring rhythm, harmony, and the expressive possibilities of the violin.

events.title: Lila Bloom
events.description: Lila Bloom is a born and raised New Yorker. With a wide range of musical influences from Ella Fitzgerald to Bjork, Lila explores grief, awe, and surrender through her relationship to nature, her body, and conversations with a higher self. Lila Bloom plays the role of the bard sharing a range of songs from tender lullabies to rage filled war cries dedicated to the wary hearts of those who dare to interrupt generational cycles, refuse complacent living, and reclaim their lives. Lila Bloom was featured as a Top Shelf Artist in NPR’s 2026 Tiny Desk contest ranking in the top 50 out of over 6000 submissions. She was also a winner of WNYC Radio's Public Song Project for her submission of an original arrangement of the jazz classic Blue Skies, with Devon Yesberger. Lila has performed her original music at the Perelman Performing Arts Center, The Tell, The Cell Theatre, Triad Theatre, Sofar Sounds, and has collaborated with artists all around the world.  She is also the lead singer in Brooklyn based Kingston Afro Beat and a member of the New York Vocal Collective led by Grammy winner Ben Bram. events.title: L CON and Foundling
events.description:
L CON is the ever-evolving project of Lisa Conway - a Swiss-Canadian sonic adventurer, songwriter, composer, researcher, recordist, and mixer based in Montréal. Her work is often minimalist, and blends analog synthesizers, tape machines, and electronics with acoustic instruments. Lisa is an alumni of the final Red Bull Music Academy (Berlin 2018), with recent album releases on Toronto labels Halocline Trance and Idée Fixe. She has received press from publications like Musicworks (cover fall 2025), The Fader, the CBC, BOMB Magazine, Exclaim, and Earmilk, and has collaborated on works presented at TIFF, the D'Haus (Dusseldorf), MaerzMusik (Berlin), The Harbourfront Centre, Hot Docs, and the Inside Out Festival. A graduate of the MA in Sonic Arts from Queen’s University Belfast, she is currently pursuing a SSHRC-funded Individualized PhD in Fine Arts (sound studies) at Concordia University.

Foundling is the project of Canadian-born, Berlin-based composer, harpist, and vocalist Erin
Lang, and drummer percussionist Constantine Karlis (NZ), and hosts many collaborations, 
presenting immersive live performances that move fluidly between composition and improvisation. 
Centred on their recent album Artemisia, (Shadow World Records UK) Foundling’s 
current concerts unfold through harp, voice, and percussion in slowly evolving forms,
where structured motifs dissolve into open, intuitive passages with voice and spoken word, 
drawing from ambient, experimental new age, and psychedelic folk traditions. 
Foundling’s live work offers intimate, emotionally resonant performances that delicately 
explore more mystical depths. Lang has toured extensively across Europe and North America,
including performances at a very wide range of venues including the Berlin and Paris Philharmonies, 
Le Grand Rex and Le Trianon in Paris all the way to alternative arts and experimental DIY spaces. For Fans of Harold Budd, Grouper, Nala Sinephro, Midori Takada, and Laraaji.

events.title: Ignore The Machine (hanno leichtmann / nils ostendorf)
events.description:
A new duo from Berlin. By and featuring Hanno Leichtmann and Nils Ostendorf. Both are seasoned musicians with eventful careers who operate within very different artistic spheres.

One of them, Hanno Leichtmann, is a veteran—and remains to this day a pioneer—of the electronic music scene that has developed in Germany’s capital since the years following the fall of the Berlin Wall, thanks to projects such as Static, the Trio Groupshow, and countless collaborations.

The other, Nils Ostendorf, plays a trumpet whose capabilities are expanded through the use of various devices. He comes more from the world of contemporary jazz and has been a sought-after musician and composer on theater stages for years.

Hanno Leichtmann and Nils Ostendorf both use—at different times of the day, in rapid succession—a recording studio in the Wedding district filled with hand-picked instruments and equipment.

When the two met at the same time in that studio in May 2026, the plan was actually just to record a series of tracks for a release by Chromacolor, another solo project by Hanno Leichtmann.

It all went faster than planned. In the end, they still had some studio time together. The result was a completely unplanned, 60-minute-long improvisation. All recorded in real time.  The six tracks featured here were created through precise and decisive edits to the improvised and recorded material. Without any overdubs added afterward.  The result is music that is open, exploratory, and not bound exclusively to any one genre. It has no qualms about engaging with the world of tonality and musical figuration. The boundaries and overlaps between ambient and jazz, free improvisation and musique concrète are blurred and constantly renegotiated. 

All the semantics and moods found here are, in principle, unstable. Every state reached is transitory. One thing leads to another. We perceive and imagine spaces of possibility that are becoming increasingly rare in the material world.  Ignore The Machine’s debut is the first release on Hanno Leichtmann’s new label, Semen Contra. It is available exclusively as a limited-edition CD. Each release includes an art print from the label head’s extensive image library.

events.description: CHRIS BENNETT «ONCE UPON A TIME» SPECIAL GUEST: RICK ROSS FEAT: ERIC UNSWORTH-HEINRICH KÖBBERLING DEUTSCH Chris Bennett begann ihre Laufbahn in Deutschland, als Lead-Sängerin von Munich Machine, der wohl erfolgreichsten Discogruppe des Produzenten Giorgio Moroder. Sie schrieb Musik für Tina Turner, The Manhattan Transfer und Randy Hall, und produzierte Keb Mo’s erste CD «Rainmaker». Seit mehr als 30 Jahren ist sie mit ihrer Band regelmäßig zu Gast im A-Trane und nahm dort 1999 ihre CD „Live in Berlin“ auf. Vier Jahre später, im Oktober 2003, folgte die zweite CD „Once Upon A Time“ Live at the A-Trane , aufgenommen während einem Gastspiel im A-Trane. Auch dieses Mal hat sie den langen Weg von Los Angeles nach Berlin nicht gescheut und bringt diesmal den Saxophonisten Rick Ross aus LA mit. Rick Ross ist ein dynamischer Multiinstrumentalist und Sänger aus Südkalifornien, der für seine gefühlvollen Darbietungen auf dem Klavier und dem Saxophon sowie für seine volle, fesselnde Stimme bekannt ist. Ursprünglich aus Indianapolis stammend, hat Rick Ross einen einzigartigen Musikstil kultiviert, der klassische Raffinesse mit zeitgenössischem Flair verbindet. Was für jede Jazzvokalistin schon ein Lob darstellen würde, bedeutet für Chris Bennett noch ein weiteres: die Anerkennung ihrer Eigenständigkeit als Interpretin und Entertainerin. Die großen Gesten sind dabei ihre Sache nicht – dieser Sängerin muss man schon aufmerksam zuhören, sie drängt sich einem nicht auf. Dass Chris Bennett jedoch die Bühne als ihren angestammten Raum betrachtet, schlägt sich auch in ihrer Diskographie nieder: bei zwei ihrer insgesamt sechs Jazzalben handelt es sich um pure Konzertmitschnitte – eindeutiges Zeichen dafür, dass die Künstlerin sich ihrer Live-Qualitäten sicher ist. Und auch ihres Publikums: „ Please welcome Chris Bennett! “ ENGLISH Chris Bennett began her career in Germany, as lead singer of Munich Machine, arguably producer Giorgio Moroder’s most successful disco group. She wrote music for Tina Turner, The Manhattan Transfer and Randy Hall, and produced Keb Mo’s first CD „Rainmaker“. She has been a regular guest at the A-Trane with her band for more than 30 years and recorded her CD „Live in Berlin“ there in 1999. Four years later, in October 2003, the second CD „Once Upon A Time“ Live at the A-Trane followed, recorded during a guest performance at the A-Trane. This time, too, she didn’t shy away from the long journey from Los Angeles to Berlin, this time bringing along saxophonist Rick Ross from LA. Rick Ross is a dynamic multi-instrumentalist and vocalist based in Southern California, known for his soulful performances on piano and saxophone, as well as his rich, captivating voice. Originally from Indianapolis, Rick has cultivated a unique musical style that blends classic sophistication with contemporary flair. What would be praise enough for any jazz vocalist, means yet another for Chris Bennett: recognition of her independence as a performer and entertainer. The big gestures are not her thing – you have to listen carefully to this singer; she doesn’t force herself on you. However, the fact that Chris Bennett regards the stage as her ancestral space is also reflected in her discography: two of her six jazz albums are pure concert recordings – a clear sign that the artist is confident of her live qualities. I am pleased to present a new edition of Domingo Fantástico, the music and variety series held at Donau115. Inspired by the great weekend television shows that shaped generations across Latin America and Spain, this event celebrates diversity, creativity, and cultural exchange in Berlin.

In this edition, we will explore the musical paths that connect Ibero-America and Europe through artists who have made Berlin a space for creation, exchange, and sonic experimentation.

The evening will feature Verde Lejos, a Berlin-based musical project that brings together artists from across Ibero-America to create a global sound. Their music combines Latin American spirit with influences from soul, groove, contemporary electronics, and alternative rock, creating a musical universe that is both danceable and introspective.

We will also welcome guest artist Fernanda Tarrech, a singer-songwriter born in Montevideo, Uruguay. After beginning her musical journey busking in the streets of her hometown and releasing her first EP, La primera revolución de los pájaros, she moved to Germany, where she has continued to develop an artistic path marked by openness, curiosity, and a close connection with audiences. In recent years she has shared stages with artists such as Paul Wetz, Bukahara, and Manu Chao while preparing her upcoming recordings.

An evening dedicated to music that travels, transforms, and finds new homes.

events.description: HILA KULIK TRIO «A Journey Swing, Soul & Original Music» FEAT : Thiago Duarte-Marc Michel The Hile Kulik Trio will present the music of her recent album « More than a change ». A presentation of her own original music, special arrangements, influenced by Swing, Jazz, and Soul along with hits of middle eastern rhythms and classical harmony. Kulik will share the stage with two of the greatest musicians in the world Jazz Scene. Virtuoso pianist, Hila Kulik is one of the most active performers on the worldwide Jazz scene. Kulik, an impressive performer, is a graduate of the prestigious Jerusalem Academy, and the Aaron Copland School of Music at Queens College New York. She has shared the stage, recorded, and toured the world with some of today’s greatest jazz musicians including: Cyrille Aimee, Antonio Hart, Wayne Tucker, Donald Harrison, and more. With Flora and Airto, worked as electric and acoustic bassist in the latest released albuns, including „If You Will“, by Flora Purim, nominated for the Grammy 2023 in the best Latin jazz album category. As a leader and composer has released one trio Album in 2021, featuring Airto Moreira, and his next album, Casas e Raízes, brings together the Afro-Brazilian roots and the last years he spent immersed in the European music scene. Has performed at festivals and clubs in the United States, Europe, South America and Asia. As a member of the Focus Year Band 2024, played with names such as Kurt Rosenwinkel, Chris Cheek, Kris Davis, Miguel Zenón and Lionel Loueke. Marc Michel Der französische Schlagzeuger und Komponist Marc Michel zählt zu den gefragtesten Rhythmusmeistern Europas. Geboren in Lyon und ausgebildet am Berklee College of Music in Boston, entwickelte er einen eigenständigen Stil, der Jazz, Improvisation, Rock und Weltmusik mühelos verbindet. Michel arbeitete bereits mit internationalen Künstlern wie Lionel Loueke, Shai Maestro, Ralph Peterson und Ari Hoenig zusammen und trat auf renommierten Bühnen und Festivals in Europa, Nordamerika und Asien auf. events.title: Jessie Monk Trio
events.description:
Jessie Monk is an artist devoted to making space for the old ways in the new world - through song, story and ritual. Drawing inspiration from the folk traditions of her gaelic-ancestry, Naarm-based artist is obsessed with old myths, poetry, stories and songs from various traditions and lineages throughout the ages. Weaving them amongst new threads of jazz/experimental sounds, Jessie and band create an atmosphere of tangible and, at the same time, experimental folklore, enchanting audiences with soaring and mystical compositions filled with poetry, symbol, dreams and humanity.

Coming from a theatrical background, she learnt a lot from performing in the Australian Premier of David Bowie’s, Lazarus and the Australian tour of Anais Mitchell’s, Hadestown. In 2023, she released her debut album, Continually Becoming, regarded as ‘Boundless Folk' by Rolling Stone Magazine - and is now touring her sophomore album - Mis O’ The Mountains - a concept album based on the myth of an ancient celtic goddess named Mis, which was nominated for AFMA’s Contemporary Folk Album of the Year, 2025. She has headlined many a Europe and UK tour and been lucky enough to support other wonderful artists like Rachel Sermanni, Ocie Elliot and Matthew and the Atlas.

events.description: Will Jacobs & The Unit WITH : Christian Keymer-Arne Imig-Brian D. Sauls FEAT : Charlotte Colace Deutsch Mit dem Treffen auf Arne Imig , Christian Keymer und Brian D. Sauls fand Will Jacobs 2023 seine neue musikalische Heimat, die unter dem Namen „Will Jacobs & The Unit“ den Soul-, Blues- und Funk-Sound der 60er Jahre mit Elementen aus Neo-Soul und modernem R&B neu interpretiert. Die dadurch geschlagene Brücke zwischen den Generationen begeistert seit jeher das Publikum vieler renommierter Jazz-Clubs und Festivals in ganz Europa. Will Jacobs verbrachte seine Jugend damit, in den Blues Clubs Chicagos von den wahren Größen des Genres zu lernen und entwickelte so einen Sound, der heutzutage nur noch selten aufzufinden ist. Durch diesen authentischen, energievollen Sound gewann er den Jugendpreis bei der Windy City Blues Challenge in Chicago und bekam kurz darauf die Chance, beim internationalen Blues Showcase in Memphis, Tennessee aufzutreten. Diese Erfolge führten ihn direkt ans renommierte Berklee College of Music, wo er sich weiteren Genres widmete. Nach mehreren Tourneen mit dem berühmten Zydeco Künstler, C.J. Chenier, einer erfolgreichen Karriere in der Blues Szene Chicagos und einem längeren musikalischen Aufenthalt in Sri Lanka wagte er 2016 den Sprung nach Europa, um von Berlin aus als Solokünstler durchzustarten. Daraufhin folgte eine Orientierungsphase in der deutschen Blues-Landschaft, zahlreichen Konzerten, unterschiedlichen Besetzungen (Blues Caravan, Marcos Coll Band, David Haynes & Friends) und der Veröffentlichung eines ersten Solo-Albums „Goldfish Blues“ bei Ruf Records. Charlotte Colace : Die in Berlin lebende Soul-Künstlerin ** Charlotte Colace ** verbindet ihre französisch-kubanischen Wurzeln mit einem Sound, der Vintage-Soul-Nostalgie und moderne Grooves vereint. Ihre ausdrucksstarke Bühnenpräsenz machte sie schnell zu einer festen Größe der Berliner Liveszene, ausgezeichnet mit dem ** Listen to Berlin Artist Award 2025 **, noch bevor sie überhaupt Musik auf Streaming-Plattformen veröffentlicht hatte. Sie hat gemeinsam mit Künstler*innen wie **Omah Lay** und **Nick Hakim** die Bühne geteilt und ihre Stimme Projekten wie **Sorvina**, **Stella & The Longos** und dem BiPoC-Chor **A Song For You** geliehen, bevor sie nun mit ihrer 4-köpfigen Live-Band ins Rampenlicht tritt. Mit über 40.000 monatlichen Spotify-Hörer*innen baut Charlotte ein eigenes, gefühlvolles Universum auf. Ihre Debüt-EP *No Way But Through* (März 2026), koproduziert mit **Tremendous Aron** (180K+ monatliche Hörer*innen), umfasst die Singles *Lose You Over Lies*, *Confrontations* und *This Feelin’* – eine rohe, cineastische Reise durch Liebe, Verlust und Selbstfindung. English In 2023 Will Jacobs found his new musical home after meeting Arne Imig (bass), Christian Keymer (keys), and Brian D. Sauls (drums). Under the name „Will Jacobs & The Unit“ they offer a fresh perspective on the soul, blues, and funk sounds of the 60s by merging them with elements of neo-soul and modern R&B. They manage to seamlessly bridge the gap between generations and have consistently delighted the audiences of many renowned jazz clubs and festivals throughout Europe. Will Jacobs spent his youth immersing himself in Chicago’s blues clubs, learning from the true greats of the genre. This foundation cultivated a rare, profound sound, which allowed him to attract local and international attention with his first band, performing at the International Blues Showcase in Memphis, Tennessee after having won Chicago’s Windy City Blues Challenge (Youth Division). These successes propelled him to the esteemed Berklee College of Music, where his focus broadened to embrace more contemporary genres. After a few successful years of gigging, composing and session work in Chicago, a musical residency in Sri Lanka, as well as touring with renowned Zydeco artist C.J. Chenier, Will embarked on his solo career, relocating to Berlin, Germany in 2016. What followed was a period of orientation in the European blues scene, numerous concerts with various lineups (Blues Caravan, Marcos Coll Band, David Haynes & Friends), and the release of his first solo album, „Goldfish Blues,“ on Ruf Records. Charlotte Colace : Independent Berlin-based soul artist ** Charlotte Colace ** draws on her French-Cuban roots to craft a sound that bridges vintage soul nostalgia with modern grooves and heartfelt storytelling. She has shared stages with artists such as **Omah Lay** and **Nick Hakim**, and contributed her voice to projects like **Sorvina, Stella & The Longos**, and the BiPoC choir **A Song For You,** before stepping into her own spotlight with her 4-piece live band. With over 40,000 monthly Spotify listeners, Charlotte is carving her own soulful universe. Her debut EP *No Way But Through* (March 2026), co-produced with **Tremendous Aron**, features singles *Lose You Over Lies*, *Confrontations*, and *This Feelin’* – a raw, cinematic journey through love, loss, and self-discovery.
